note: Large, well-treed campground in Peter Lougheed PP near the Kananaskis Lakes, with the Boulton Creek Trading Post (store, token showers), hiking trails and paved bike paths. All campers check in at the Boulton store before going to a site. Power sites are in Loops B (15-amp) and E (30-amp); 18 of Loop A's 22 sites are listed under 23 ft. Water and sewage services run about early June to early September, weather permitting. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 84 unserviced / 35 power-water / 31 full-hookup (15/30-amp) sites plus 6 walk-in tent, $31/$47/$55, season May 7 - Oct 12 (2026), reservable 90 days ahead, showers, flush toilets, store, dump. Count 160 -> 156; added max length 61, pull-throughs, toilets, potable water; note rewritten without counts/rates.
